name: collection-field
title: Collection Field
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A list edited in place inside a form: the user adds an item and fills it right there (payment methods, lots, recipients). Rows, state and validation stay in the app (`useFieldArray`'s `fields`, `append`, `remove`). `CollectionField` takes the `label` (a legend), `description`, the list's `error`, `itemCount`, `onAdd` and `addLabel`; `minItems` removes the remove buttons at the minimum and `maxItems` swaps the add button for a note once reached; an empty list shows `emptyMessage`. Adding announces the new item and focuses its first field; removing announces it and focuses the add button. `CollectionFieldItem` (`label` numbered, "Lot 2", which also names its remove button; `onRemove`) has two layouts: `row` for a few fields side by side on wide screens with the remove button at the end, and `group` for many fields under a visible legend with a static border, so items stay apart when fields stack on small screens. `CollectionFieldSummary` with `CollectionFieldSummaryItem` shows the total, what is allocated and what remains (`isEmphasized`: by size and weight, with the state in words). Lists filled elsewhere first and only shown here (edited in a dialog, listed in a table) are a composition of `data-grid`/`item` and `dialog`, not this block. Built-in text is in English; translate it with `i18n.labels`.
